Question 3
?

The vector-valued function r(x,θ) parametrizes the surface of revolution generated by rotating the curve y=1−x2 by 2π radians about the x-axis for x∈[−1,1]. Which of the following could be r?

a
⟨1−x2cos⁡θ,1−x2sin⁡θ,x⟩
b
⟨1−x2sin⁡θ,1−x2cos⁡θ,x⟩
c
⟨x,1−x2csc⁡θ,1−x2sec⁡θ⟩
d
⟨x,1−x2cos⁡θ,1−x2sin⁡θ⟩
e
⟨x,1−x2sin⁡θ,1−x2cos⁡θ⟩
Submit
